question: Should OpenClaw core permanently own both a public plugin `safetyDiagnostics` API and durable shared SQLite history for this AI-safety taxonomy, or should the initial work be narrowed to existing diagnostics/plugin seams?
rationale: This choice creates a plugin SDK contract, a manifest capability, privacy/retention expectations, and a persisted operator data model; source review cannot determine the intended permanent product boundary.

options.title: Approve a narrow core contract
options.body: Keep a documented generic event substrate only after defining the plugin API, authorization, retention/privacy, and upgrade contract, then repair the implementation to that approved scope.

options.title: Keep the feature plugin-owned
options.body: Avoid adding a new core SDK and shared-state surface by implementing optional collection, exporter, and operator UI behavior in the diagnostics/plugin ecosystem.

options.title: Defer the feature direction
options.body: Pause this broad branch until an owner sponsors the intended safety-observability product and data-retention model.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow core contract
recommendation.body: Keep a documented generic event substrate only after defining the plugin API, authorization, retention/privacy, and upgrade contract, then repair the implementation to that approved scope.

likelyOwner.reason: The author owns the open design proposal and can supply the requested scope/proof, while a repository owner must make the final product decision.
